clauses.title: 1. Introduction
clauses.raw_block:
## 1. Introduction
GAuth Core Protocol describes mechanisms for delegation, policy evaluation, audit traceability and revocation. (Placeholder text.)

clauses.title: 2. Policy Bundle Integrity

normative_statements.text: Implementations MUST link each policy bundle to the previous via a cryptographic hash to ensure chain integrity.
A client SHOULD be able to query provenance metadata including bundle hash, timestamp, and issuer identity.

clauses.raw_block:
## 2. Policy Bundle Integrity
Implementations MUST link each policy bundle to the previous via a cryptographic hash to ensure chain integrity.
A client SHOULD be able to query provenance metadata including bundle hash, timestamp, and issuer identity.

clauses.title: 3. Delegation & Revocation

normative_statements.text: Each delegation artifact MUST contain a reference to its parent delegation or root authority.
Revocation entries MUST NOT be alterable once appended.
Implementations SHOULD provide an externally verifiable anchor for revocation chains.

clauses.raw_block:
## 3. Delegation & Revocation
Each delegation artifact MUST contain a reference to its parent delegation or root authority.
Revocation entries MUST NOT be alterable once appended.
Implementations SHOULD provide an externally verifiable anchor for revocation chains.

clauses.title: 4. Audit Logging

normative_statements.text: Audit events MUST capture decision inputs sufficient for deterministic replay.
Audit chain hashes MAY be anchored to external trusted timestamp services.

clauses.raw_block:
## 4. Audit Logging
Audit events MUST capture decision inputs sufficient for deterministic replay.
Audit chain hashes MAY be anchored to external trusted timestamp services.

clauses.title: 5. Replay Protection

normative_statements.text: Token creation endpoints MUST reject previously seen nonces or identifiers to prevent replay.

clauses.raw_block:
## 5. Replay Protection
Token creation endpoints MUST reject previously seen nonces or identifiers to prevent replay.

clauses.title: 6. Cryptographic Requirements

normative_statements.text: Signatures MUST employ algorithms with public verifiability.
HMAC symmetric-only schemes SHOULD NOT be used for cross-tenant verification contexts.

clauses.raw_block:
## 6. Cryptographic Requirements
Signatures MUST employ algorithms with public verifiability.
HMAC symmetric-only schemes SHOULD NOT be used for cross-tenant verification contexts.

clauses.title: 1. Power of Attorney Structure

normative_statements.text: A Power of Attorney (POA) document MUST enumerate principal, delegate, scope and validity period.
It SHOULD include formal requirements enabling external verification.

clauses.raw_block:
## 1. Power of Attorney Structure
A Power of Attorney (POA) document MUST enumerate principal, delegate, scope and validity period.
It SHOULD include formal requirements enabling external verification.

clauses.title: 2. Scope Semantics

normative_statements.text: Scope definitions MUST support hierarchical narrowing.
Implementations SHOULD allow pattern or range expressions for advanced narrowing.

clauses.raw_block:
## 2. Scope Semantics
Scope definitions MUST support hierarchical narrowing.
Implementations SHOULD allow pattern or range expressions for advanced narrowing.

clauses.title: 3. Validity Period

normative_statements.text: POA artifacts MUST define `valid_from` and `valid_until` timestamps.
Verification logic SHOULD consider reasonable clock skew.

clauses.raw_block:
## 3. Validity Period
POA artifacts MUST define `valid_from` and `valid_until` timestamps.
Verification logic SHOULD consider reasonable clock skew.

clauses.title: 4. Formal Requirements

normative_statements.text: Formal requirements MAY include notarization references and multi-signature attestations.

clauses.raw_block:
## 4. Formal Requirements
Formal requirements MAY include notarization references and multi-signature attestations.

clauses.title: 5. Power Limits

normative_statements.text: Quantitative limits MUST be enforceable (e.g., maximum transaction value, daily quota).

clauses.raw_block:
## 5. Power Limits
Quantitative limits MUST be enforceable (e.g., maximum transaction value, daily quota).

clauses.title: 6. Rights & Obligations

normative_statements.text: Rights granted and obligations imposed SHOULD be serialized canonically and hashed.

clauses.raw_block:
## 6. Rights & Obligations
Rights granted and obligations imposed SHOULD be serialized canonically and hashed.

clauses.title: 7. Special Conditions

normative_statements.text: Special conditions MAY specify exceptional overrides subject to stricter audit.

clauses.raw_block:
## 7. Special Conditions
Special conditions MAY specify exceptional overrides subject to stricter audit.

clauses.title: 8. Joint Signatures

normative_statements.text: Multi-party representation MUST support threshold semantics (M-of-N) with aggregate verification.

clauses.raw_block:
## 8. Joint Signatures
Multi-party representation MUST support threshold semantics (M-of-N) with aggregate verification.

clauses.title: 9. Canonical Serialization

normative_statements.text: Canonical POA digest MUST be stable under field reordering and extraneous whitespace removal.

clauses.raw_block:
## 9. Canonical Serialization
Canonical POA digest MUST be stable under field reordering and extraneous whitespace removal.

clauses.title: 10. Revocation Semantics

normative_statements.text: Revocation entries MUST immediately invalidate derived delegations.
Revocation chains SHOULD be externally anchored.

clauses.raw_block:
## 10. Revocation Semantics
Revocation entries MUST immediately invalidate derived delegations.
Revocation chains SHOULD be externally anchored.
